Asset type: MMO Idle small rhythm-readout payload glyph, final 32x32 PNG, displayed at 24px inside a HUD ring label.
Primary request: one open ankle-shackle curve with two thick downward anchored prongs; a restraint anchored in place, no plant.
Composition: one centered bold connected symbol occupying 72 percent of square canvas with generous padding. Extremely clear silhouette at 24px, thick strokes and broad negative spaces.
Style: restrained flat pixel-art fantasy HUD glyph; crisp intentional chunky pixel clusters, two broad value groups, hard dark outline. No fine detail, no gradients, no soft glow.
Palette: neutral warm ivory #e9e6d2 with pale slate #a8b1b8 and charcoal outline. Keep glyph neutral so the independently coloured moment ring remains meaningful.
Background: genuine transparency.
Constraints: no baked ring, circular container, timing sweep, iron plaque, ornamental tile, or object scene. No words, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, badge, border, frame, pedestal, scene, character, face, jewellery setting, tiny filigree, particle cloud, realistic rendering, or additional unrelated objects. Generate this ONE icon alone.
entries.notes: W1-E 2026-10-03. Built-in OpenAI imagegen candidate; control payload. Neutral glyph inside independently lane-coloured moment ring. Pending designer review. PixelLab endpoint is gallery-schema compatibility only.
